Rep. By The Pp, Assam

Advocate for the Respondent : Pp, Assam
Page No.# 2/3 Before Hon'Ble Mrs. Justice Susmita Phukan Khaund 21.04.2023

1. Heard Mr. A. Paramanik, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner as well as Mr. K.K. Parasar,
learned Addl. P.P. appearing for the State respondent.
2.

The petitioner, namely, Md. Jinnat Ali, has filed this application under Section 438 Cr.P.C with prayer for pre-arrest bail as he is apprehending arrest in connection with Rangia P.S. Case No.
27/2023, under Section 420 IPC.
3.
I have considered the submissions at the Bar.
4. The FIR unfolds that the informant Md. Usman Ali had learnt that from his bank account an amount of Rs. 605500/- was withdrawn fraudulently by using his ATM and Google Pay.

It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that son-in-law of Md. Unman Ali is the uncle of the petitioner,
Md. Jinnat Ali and his name is Rasid Ali.
Rasid Ali had procured Usman Ali's ATM card.

sentences.text: The learned Addl. P.P. has raised objection stating that there are incriminating materials in the case diary against the petitioner.
The petitioner has helped the accused Rasid Ali in siphoning of funds through Google Pay of Md. Usman Ali and Rs. 605500/- was withdrawn from the account of Usman Ali into the account of Rasid Ali.
The present petitioner has also admitted that he has received Rs. 67,000/- from Rasid Ali.

6. It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that he is willing to return the amount of Rs. 67,000/-
to the informant.
It is submitted that he is not the main accused and the main accused is Rasid Ali.
It is also submitted that investigation has progressed to a considerable extent.
Custodial interrogation may not be necessary for further progress of investigation.
7. In view of my foregoing discussions, petition is allowed.

8. In the event of his arrest, the petitioner shall be enlarged on bail of Rs. 30,000/- with a suitable surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority, under conditions that, Page No.#
3/3

( i) the petitioner will not exercise threats to the witnesses and will not tamper with the evidence, and (ii) the petitioner will appear before the I/O within 10(ten) days and co- operate with the investigation.
On violation of any bail conditions, this bail will be cancelled.
Send back the case diary.
